title: Operations Coordinator
summary: Coordinate biospecimen projects from scoping through delivery, working closely with providers and end users.

seo.metaDescription: Coordinate biospecimen projects end to end at Specimen Bio.

children.text: You will keep collections on track: confirming specs, coordinating with providers, tracking timelines, and ensuring samples arrive as agreed.
Own day-to-day project coordination across active collections. Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders and provider sites. Flag risks early and help resolve logistics issues.
Experience coordinating complex projects, ideally in life sciences or healthcare. Strong written communication, comfort with detail, and a calm approach under shifting timelines.

title: Business Development Associate
summary: Build relationships with biospecimen end users and help scope new procurement opportunities.

seo.metaDescription: Grow Specimen Bio’s relationships with biospecimen end users.

children.text: You will identify and qualify opportunities with pharma, biotech, and diagnostic teams that need thoughtful biospecimen procurement.
Reach out to prospective end users, run discovery conversations, and partner with the team to propose practical collection paths. Keep the pipeline organized and follow through on next steps.
Curiosity about science and customer needs, clear communication, and comfort operating in an early-stage environment. Prior BD or account experience in life sciences is a plus.
